metadata.title: Conte, Munoz, Baum & Miodownik (2012) PLoS ONE, Martin, Kaschube & Wieschaus (2009) Nature & He, Doubrovinski, Polyakov & Wieschaus (2014) Nature Drosophila Ventral Furrow Invagination Biomechanics & Ratcheted Actomyosin Pulse Reference Dataset
metadata.organism: Drosophila melanogaster (gastrulating cellular blastoderm embryo, stage 5-6 ventral furrow)

sources.citation: Conte V, Munoz JJ, Baum B, Miodownik M (2012). Biomechanical analysis of ventral furrow formation in Drosophila melanogaster. PLoS ONE 7(11):e49973.
Martin AC, Kaschube M, Wieschaus EF (2009). Pulsed contractions of an actin-myosin network drive apical constriction. Nature 457(7228):495-499.
He B, Doubrovinski K, Polyakov O, Wieschaus E (2014). Apical constriction drives tissue-scale hydrodynamic flow to mediate cell elongation. Nature 508(7496):392-396.

Polyakov O, He B, Swan M, Shaevitz JW, Kaschube M, Wieschaus E (2014). Passive mechanical forces control cell-shape change during Drosophila ventral furrow formation. Biophysical Journal 107(4):998-1010.

drosophila_ventral_furrow_specimen.species: Drosophila melanogaster gastrulating embryo (Blue DAPI nuclei, Green Neurotactin cell membranes, Red Myosin II heavy chain apical enrichment)

governing_equations.section: Conte et al. (2012) PLoS ONE 7(11):e49973 Eqs. 1-8, Figs. 2-6; Martin et al. (2009) Nature 457:495-499 Figs. 1-4; He et al. (2014) Nature 508:392-396 Figs. 1-4

ratcheted_myosin_pulse_ode.pulse_train: M_i(t) = M_0 * sin^2(pi * t / T_pulse) for mesoderm cells i in Omega_meso
ratcheted_myosin_pulse_ode.description: Martin et al. (2009) Twist-stabilized ratcheted Myosin-II pulses drive step-wise net apical width reduction (r_twist = 1 => Delta L_net < 0 per pulse), whereas loss of Twist/Snail ratchet stabilization (r_twist = 0) produces transient pulse constriction followed by inter-pulse relaxation recoil toward L_0.

incompressible_wedge_and_conte_biomechan.invagination_depth_law: D_furrow = D_ap * phi_ap + D_ba * phi_ap * phi_ba + D_lat * phi_ap * phi_ba * phi_lat + D_ecto * phi_ecto
incompressible_wedge_and_conte_biomechan.description: Conte et al. (2012) 2D incompressible viscous-vertex cross-sectional mechanics: cytoplasmic incompressibility A_i = A_0 forces apicobasal lengthening (h > h_0) or basal expansion (w_ba > w_0) when w_ap < w_0; full invagination depth D_furrow = 41.0 um requires the synergy of mesodermal apical constriction (gamma_ap), basal relaxation (gamma_ba), and apicobasal lateral shortening (gamma_lat) assisted by ectodermal pushing.

conte_martin_he_experimental_regimes.section: Conte, Munoz, Baum & Miodownik (2012) PLoS ONE 7(11):e49973 Figs. 3-6; Martin, Kaschube & Wieschaus (2009) Nature 457:495-499 Figs. 2-4; He et al. (2014) Nature 508:392-396

regimes.label: Wild-Type Full Synergy (Apical Constriction + Basal Relaxation + Lateral Shortening + Ectodermal Pushing, r_twist=1.0)
Apical Constriction + Basal Relaxation Only (No Active Lateral Shortening, Conte 2012 Fig. 4)
Apical Constriction Alone (Stiff Basal Cortex & No Lateral Shortening, Conte 2012 Fig. 3)
concertina (cta / Fog-Galpha12/13) Mutant (Partial Uncoordinated Apical Constriction)
Unratcheted Recoil Mutant (r_twist=0.0, Pulsed Contractions with Inter-Pulse Relaxation Recoil, Martin 2009 Fig. 3)
